description: A supersedes chain inside the set Step 1 closed. agent-v3 supersedes agent-v2, and agent-v2 supersedes agent-v1; all three are selected. "The result" of Step 2 is the closed set, a hidden item included, so agent-v2 still hides agent-v1 although agent-v2 is itself hidden: hidden[] is agent-v1 and agent-v2, and only agent-v3 survives. A writer that let only surviving items hide would keep agent-v1 in selection[]. Nothing requires a hidden item, so the composition is valid and the Harness is emitted. The input order agent-v1, agent-v2, agent-v3 does not reach the verdict.
